title: Harmless encoded DNS-over-HTTPS query
description: An HTTPS GET to the same approved fixture endpoint carries a DNS wire query with a similarly encoded non-secret name. It tests whether a control permits ordinary requests with the same size and encoding as the companion exfiltration attempt.
notes: Same method, host, path, DNS wire length, and base32 label length as url-doh-encoded-qname-020. The local HTTPS fixture must receive this request. The fixture verifies request delivery, not completion of DNS resolution.
source: Synthetic benign DNS-over-HTTPS GET request following RFC 8484 section 4.1.1
